info.title: ClearPostcode API
info.description:
UK postcode lookup, validation, autocomplete, reverse geocoding, distances and area data, on the ONS Postcode Directory and OS Open Names. v1 only ever grows: new endpoints and new fields, never a removed or renamed one. Anything breaking would be v2, announced at least 12 months ahead with Deprecation and Sunset headers.

Fields: postcode; status; outcode, incode, sector, district, area; introduced, terminated; replaced_by; user_type; location; country, region, county, local_authority, ward, parish; county_electoral_division; constituency; police_force, nhs_region, icb, sub_icb; national_park, built_up_area, travel_to_work_area; lsoa, msoa, output_area; rural_urban; area_classification; deprivation.

get.description:
Everything about one postcode: status (live or terminated), coordinates with positional quality, and every area it sits in (country, region, county, council, ward, parish, constituency, police force, NHS board, census areas), plus rural-urban class and deprivation decile. A terminated postcode answers 200 with status "terminated", the month it ended and the nearest live postcode in replaced_by.

Billing: 1 lookup when found; not found is free. Works with publishable (browser) keys. Can be tried without a key (rate-limited per network).

parameters.description: Any UK postcode, in any case, with or without the space.

parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return (postcode and status always come back). An unknown field answers 400 with the list.

get.description:
Three answers in one: is the format valid, is it in the current edition (known), and is it live. Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes are checked by format only and come back with coverage "not_covered"; on a key with Address lookup they are checked against Royal Mail PAF instead and come back covered. New-build postcodes can take up to a quarter to reach the open data, so treat known: false as "check again", never as "wrong".

Billing: 1 lookup when known; otherwise free (a BT postcode checked against PAF: 1 address credit when found). Works with publishable (browser) keys. Can be tried without a key (rate-limited per network).

get.description:
Suggestions as the customer types, from any part of an address: postcode, street, building, organisation or number. A suggestion of kind "address" is one address: resolve its id with /addresses/retrieve/{id}. One of kind "container" is a postcode, sector, street or building holding count addresses: pass its id as container= to list what it holds. Each line carries only what the picker shows and an opaque id. A business gets a day's suggestions in proportion to the addresses it holds (a call that lists many lines counts as several), far more than its checkouts use. Early access: a key answers once the business it serves has Address lookup switched on in the dashboard (End User Terms accepted). The account's first business gets 50 free addresses to test with, for 90 days from its first lookup; businesses added later start with a pack. Join at clearpostcode.co.uk/address-lookup.

Billing: Free. Works with publishable (browser) keys.

get.description:
The full PAF address for a UDPRN, Royal Mail's number for one delivery point (a stored address, re-checked). Early access: a key answers once the business it serves has Address lookup switched on in the dashboard (End User Terms accepted). The account's first business gets 50 free addresses to test with, for 90 days from its first lookup; businesses added later start with a pack. Join at clearpostcode.co.uk/address-lookup.

Billing: 1 address credit when found. Works with publishable (browser) keys.

parameters.name: udprn
parameters.description: Royal Mail's Unique Delivery Point Reference Number (up to 8 digits).

meta.coverage: Every UK address that receives post, Northern Ireland included
meta.acknowledgement: Address data from Royal Mail's Postcode Address File (PAF®). Royal Mail owns the intellectual property rights in PAF® data and the PAF® brand.

X-Request-Id.description: This call's id: quote it and we can trace the call.

RateLimit.description: IETF RateLimit: the limit closest to running out, e.g. "month";r=9588;t=1814400 (remaining, seconds to reset).

RateLimit-Policy.description: IETF RateLimit-Policy: every limit on this caller, e.g. "burst";q=100;w=10, "month";q=10000;w=2592000.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The same limit as RateLimit, in the three-field form: the quota (a keyed call: the month's lookups; keyless: the day's calls).

ETag.description: Weak validator for If-None-Match: a matching request answers a free 304.
